resolution: Recovered the user's 1,016-edit Compact Car resident mesh without reload or discard. Diagnosed that the live model (4,611 triangles, generation 3043) differed from the prior disk blob (5,016 triangles) because AppFrame hot reload reset activeSessionModelIdRef to null, making Ctrl+S silently call Save with no model id. Rebound the native session synchronously from the active workspace model before ModelView mounts; the pending autosave then wrote the live 4,611-triangle mesh. Verified saved, mount, and resident counts all equal 4,611 and modelDirty is false. Added a regression test and ReleaseFast editor build. No model asset was committed.
